title: Sum of Beauty of all substring
problemStatement: Master “Sum of Beauty of all substring” (Medium String Problems) the way an interviewer expects: classify, brute, optimize, prove.
intuition: "Sum of Beauty of all substring": define recursion return value; handle None; combine children. Ask if BST properties help.

approaches.title: Brute recompute from every node
approaches.idea: Re-run DFS from many roots when applicable for "Sum of Beauty of all substring".

approaches.title: Optimal one-pass tree DP / traversal
approaches.idea: Single DFS returning the metric needed for "Sum of Beauty of all substring".
approaches.code:
def solve(root):
    ans = 0
    def dfs(n):
        nonlocal ans
        if not n: return 0
        L, R = dfs(n.left), dfs(n.right)
        # adapt combine for "Sum of Beauty of all substring"
        ans = max(ans, L + R)
        return 1 + max(L, R)
    dfs(root)
    return ans
